blurb: Guests sail aboard two yachts: the historic 1935 ketch Lady Patty and the modern 44-foot Leopard catamaran Epiphany. Trips include public and private charters, with options for day sails, sunset cruises, and sailing lessons. The experience includes scenic views of the Chesapeake Bay, wildlife sightings, and opportunities to relax or participate in sailing.

quotes.author: Kelly Upton
quotes.text: AMAZING! Words cannot describe how perfect everything was aboard the gorgeous and spacious Epiphany, and the friendly and fun atmosphere with Captain Scott & First Mate Diane! We celebrated my parents 50th anniversary and they surprised us with decorations! They were also extremely welcoming and accommodating to my 6 year old daughter who was so excited to explore the boat as well as my husband who was newly on crutches. We loved every minute and will absolutely do this again in the future!

quotes.author: Erin Parfitt
quotes.text: A simply magical experience on the water with Captain GM and first mate Laura. Consummate hosts! The boat is gorgeous and spotless. We had our choice of great seating at the front and the back of the boat. Laura served us our champagne and offered to prepare our charcuterie. (We were too engrossed in the sailing to want to eat though!) It was a perfect day for a sail and everything was amazing. Can’t imagine a better day on the water. Highly recommend this experience! Don’t miss it!

quotes.author: Tamara Lawrence
quotes.text: Hands down the best way to see Maryland! We had such a fabulous time on the water in such a beautiful boat. Diane is amazing! She went out of here way to make sure it was a memorial event and Captain Scott knew all the best places for the perfect views. We will definitely be back next time we visit. Thank you both so much!

quotes.author: Jennifer Fowler
quotes.text: I surprised my boyfriend with a sunset cruise with St. Michael’s Sailing Charters for his birthday. We had such an amazing time! Laura and GM were amazing hosts and we felt truly pampered. The catamaran is stunning and so comfortable. I highly recommend it!
